subject: Pricing playbook + recommended path: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>
To: Elaine Park <elaine.park@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pricing playbook + recommended path: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC

Hi Elaine — thanks again for carving out time today. Quick recap from our call and an attached playbook with modeled examples. Attaching: redwood_pricing_playbook_v1.pdf and a first-pass estimate spreadsheet (estimate_acme_health_20270519.xlsx).

Key points we covered:
- Deployment choices: Hosted API (fastest to ship), Dedicated (reserved GPU capacity for production scale), Private VPC/on‑prem (for regulated PHI workflows with customer-managed networking).
- Tradeoffs we highlighted:
  * Hosted API: per-token billing, no infra overhead, ideal for POC and early product-market fit. Example ballpark: $0.0008–$0.0012 per token for standard generation models; streaming latency typically 50–200ms depending on model/seq length.
  * Dedicated (reserved commits): predictable monthly cost, lower per-token equivalent when utilization is high. Example: a $25k/month reserved pool covering ~1B tokens/month -> equivalent ~ $0.000025/token at high utilization but requires commit and forecast accuracy.
  * Private VPC / On-prem: upfront deployment + infra. Good for strict compliance; typical plan mixes a platform fee, infra sizing, and a 12–36 month support contract. One-time onboarding + validation (~$40k–$120k) plus ongoing managed fees.

What I need from you to finalize the estimate:
1) Expected average tokens/month (you gave a rough 200M–500M range on the call; please confirm a preferred scenario).
2) Peak QPS and P95 latency SLO for inference (helps sizing Dedicated pools).
3) Data residency/compliance must-haves (PHI allowed? audit retention windows?).
4) Procurement timeline and PO/contract owner (if you already have a template we can pre-fill).

Immediate recommendation (based on what we heard): Start with Hosted API for a 6–8 week pilot to validate prompts and SLAs, then migrate to a 12-month Dedicated reserved pool when you hit consistent sustained throughput. For regulated flows that will store/process PHI, we recommend Private VPC for production, or Dedicated within a segregated tenant if VPC is not required. The attached spreadsheet includes a model that shows the crossover point between Hosted and Dedicated for different utilization profiles.

Next steps:
- Can you confirm the three items above by EOD Friday?
- Would next Wed 10:00–11:00 PT for a short follow-up to walk the estimate work for Acme Health work?

Thanks — I’ll pin the pricing playbook notes in the thread and create a clean MLP (mutual action plan) doc once we confirm volumes.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing playbook + recommended path: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC

Thanks Vanessa — useful summary and appreciate the spreadsheet. A few clarifications from our side:
- Tokens: we expect ~300M tokens/month steady-state after rollout, with a POC month closer to 50M.
- Peak: burst QPS around 180 requests/sec (short generator responses up to 1–2k tokens), target P95 latency <350ms.
- Compliance: some flows will include PHI. We will need SOC 2 evidence and an option for VPC or dedicated tenancy.
- Procurement: procurement@acmehealth.com will own contracts; timeline is aggressive — want production SLA in ~10–12 weeks if the POC succeeds.

Attaching our security requirements doc for your review: security_requirements_acme.pdf

Can you include a column in the estimate showing: (A) Hosted POC cost, (B) 12m dedicated commit amortized cost, (C) Private VPC overhead (onetime + monthly)? Also confirm typical ramp and onboarding lead times for Dedicated vs Private VPC.

— Elaine Park
Director, AI Product| Acme Health
elaine.park@acmehealth.com

Attachment: security_requirements_acme.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pricing playbook + recommended path: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC (internal)

Looping in Karthik for sizing input. Quick modeling notes after eyeballing Elaine’s numbers:
- Use cases: 300M tokens/month steady state. If avg response 800 tokens per request at 180 QPS bursts, that fits roughly into a Dedicated pool with 2–3 x A100-equivalent GPUs (depends on model family & quantization).
- Pricing approach to show in spreadsheet (three scenarios):
  1) Hosted POC: pay-as-you-go per token. For modeling we should show two per-token tiers: standard gen $0.0009/token, advanced gen $0.0016/token. Include 10% pilot discount.
  2) 12-month Dedicated reserved: break out monthly commit bands: $15k/month (low) -> $50k/month (high). Show effective token equivalent at 60%/80% utilization. Add a note about minimum utilization risk.
  3) Private VPC: show one-time onboarding (estimate $75k) + monthly managed fee ($12k) + infra amortization. Also note gating items: on-prem HW lead times 6–10 weeks if they want physical racks.

Recommendation to present to Acme: Start POC on Hosted (30–45 days) + work on procurement/IR for Dedicated commit in parallel. If PHI will be in production, run a parallel Private VPC feasibility assessment; we can offer a Dedicated-isolated tenant as interim compliance mitigation.

I updated estimate_acme_health_20270519.xlsx with the three scenarios and a sensitivity table — see attached. Karthik, can you sanity-check GPU sizing and lead times?

— Marissa
Principal Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Pricing playbook + recommended path: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC

Elaine — thanks for the details and the security doc. We updated the estimate spreadsheet with the three columns you requested (Hosted POC / 12m Dedicated / Private VPC) and added a ramp plan and onboarding lead times. Highlights attached: estimate_acme_health_20270519.xlsx.

Quick summary of the numbers we added (high level):
- Hosted POC (50M token month): ~$45k (includes pilot discount and support hours) — fastest path, 1–2 days API access, no infra setup.
- Production Hosted (300M tokens/month): ~$270k/month (per-token at $0.0009) — predictable but can be costly at scale.
- 12m Dedicated reserved (recommended if >200M sustained): $28k/month base commit -> equivalent ~$0.00009–$0.00015/token depending on utilization assumptions (we show 60/80/95% utilization scenarios). This includes priority capacity, predictable latency, and a migration plan. Requires a 30–45 day lead time for capacity reservation.
- Private VPC: one-time onboarding & deployment $75k (typical), monthly managed + infra amortized ~$18k/month (highly dependent on HW choices). Lead time: 6–10 weeks for on‑prem procurement; 3–6 weeks for cloud VPC deployment. Also includes SOC2 artifact handoff and audit checklist we can pre-populate.

Proposed next steps:
1) Confirm which cost scenario you want us to expand in the MLP (Hosted-first + Dedicated migration, or Private VPC ASAP) by Tue EOD.
2) Please share the procurement contact if you want the contract team to draft a 12-month commitment term sheet.
3) If helpful, we can schedule a 45-minute deep-dive with Solutions + Security to walk the SOC2 artifacts and VPC checklist next Thu 10:00 PT.

I’ll drop the updated sheet and a short mutual action plan in a shared Drive and follow up with a calendar invite for the deep-dive if you confirm.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

— Vanessa Ortiz
